findings.title: Mitel Product Security Advisory MISA-2025-0009
findings.summary_md: Mitel's own advisory for MISA-2025-0009, first issued 2025-07-23 and revised to version 2.0 on 2026-01-05. It tracks CVE-2025-67822 as a critical authentication bypass in the Provisioning Manager component of MiVoice MX-ONE, scored CVSS 3.1 9.4 with vector AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:H/A:H. Affected releases are 7.3 (7.3.0.0.50) through 7.8 SP1 (7.8.1.0.14), remediated by patches MXO-15711_78SP0 and MXO-15711_78SP1.

findings.title: Mitel security advisory (AV25-449) - Canadian Centre for Cyber Security
findings.summary_md: The Canadian Cyber Centre advisory AV25-449, published 2025-07-23, relays Mitel's advisories for critical flaws in MiVoice MX-ONE and MiCollab. It lists MiVoice MX-ONE versions 3 (7.3.0.0.50) to 7.8 SP1 (7.8.1.0.14) as affected and links the vendor bulletin MISA-2025-0009. It notes the critical authentication bypass carried a CVSSv3 score of 9.4 and that no CVE identifier was assigned at the time of publication.

findings.title: Critical Mitel Flaw Lets Hackers Bypass Login, Gain Full Access to MiVoice MX-ONE Systems - The Hacker News
findings.summary_md: Coverage dated 2025-07-24 describing the critical-severity authentication bypass in Mitel MiVoice MX-ONE and quoting the vendor text that a successful exploit could allow an attacker to gain unauthorized access to user or admin accounts. At the time of reporting the flaw was still awaiting a CVE assignment. It frames the issue alongside a separately patched SQL injection in Mitel MiCollab.

findings.title: Mitel patches critical MiVoice MX-ONE Auth bypass flaw - Security Affairs
findings.summary_md: Security Affairs reported the CVSS 9.4 authentication bypass in MiVoice MX-ONE on 2025-07-25, noting weak access controls let attackers reach user or admin accounts. The flaw resides in the Provisioning Manager component. The same advisory set included an SQL injection in MiCollab tracked as CVE-2025-52914 with a CVSS score of 8.8.

findings.title: NVD - CVE-2025-67822
findings.summary_md: NVD published CVE-2025-67822 on 2026-01-15 with status Analyzed. The record describes an improper-authentication bypass in the Provisioning Manager component of Mitel MiVoice MX-ONE 7.3 (7.3.0.0.50) through 7.8 SP1 (7.8.1.0.14) that could let an unauthenticated attacker gain unauthorized access to user or admin accounts. It carries a CVSS 3.1 base score of 9.4.
